name: Mocallure 18 Color Glitter Kit | High-Pigment Sparkle Palette for Eyes, Lips & Face Makeup
description:
Unleash your inner glam with the Mocallure 18 Color Glitter Kit, your ultimate sparkle companion for any occasion. Featuring 18 vibrant, high-pigment glitter shades, this versatile palette lets you create bold, shimmering looks for eyes, lips, and full-face artistry. With its smooth texture and long-lasting formula, the colors glide on effortlessly and stay radiant all day — perfect for parties, festivals, and creative makeup styles.
Key Features:
 18 glitter shades for versatile creative looks
 High-pigment formula with brilliant shine
 Smooth texture for easy, even application
 Long-lasting wear without fallout
 Suitable for eyes, lips, and body makeup
 Ideal for parties, events, and artistic use
How to Use:
1⃣ Apply a thin layer of glitter primer or base.
2⃣ Use a brush or fingertip to pat glitter onto desired area.
3⃣ Blend gently for even coverage.
4⃣ Remove easily with makeup remover.
Ingredients:
Mica, Polyethylene Terephthalate, Mineral Oil, Paraffin, Silica, Pigments, Vitamin E.
Safety Information:
 For external use only.
 Avoid contact with eyes and open wounds.
 Keep away from children.
 Store in a cool, dry place.
Package Includes:
 1 × Mocallure 18 Color Glitter Palette
